arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import numpy as np

# Data: Matured noninterest-bearing debt (millions of dollars) for fiscal years 1960-1967
data = {
    1960: 280,
    1961: 240,
    1962: 211,
    1963: 157,
    1964: 139,
    1965: 110,
    1966: 95,
    1967: 88
}

alpha = 0.4

# Single exponential smoothing
# Initialize S_0 with the first observation
years = sorted(data.keys())
values = [data[y] for y in years]

# S_1960 = X_1960 (first observation)
S = {}
S[years[0]] = values[0]

print("Single Exponential Smoothing (alpha = 0.4)")
print("=" * 50)
print(f"Year\tActual (X_t)\tSmoothed (S_t)")
print(f"{years[0]}\t{values[0]}\t\t{S[years[0]]}")

# Apply exponential smoothing for subsequent years
for i in range(1, len(years)):
    year = years[i]
    actual = values[i]
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    S[year] = alpha * actual + (1 - alpha) * S[prev_year]
    print(f"{year}\t{actual}\t\t{S[year]:.2f}")

# Forecast for 1968 is the smoothed value for 1967
forecast_1968 = S[years[-1]]
print("=" * 50)
print(f"\nForecast for FY 1968: {forecast_1968:.2f} million dollars")
EOF
